data.one_liner: A SerialPort library using win32 API for connecting real devices via serial port on Windows.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface to list available COM ports, open serial connections with specific configurations like baud rate and stop bits, and perform read and write operations using the Win32 API.
use_when: You need to communicate with hardware connected via a serial port on Windows.
You are building a desktop application targeting Windows that talks to microcontrollers, sensors, or serial devices.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform serial port support (this package only supports Windows).
You require high-level reactive streams for continuous reading without imperative buffer management.
strengths: Allows querying detailed port metadata including friendly names, hardware IDs, and manufacturer names.
Provides flexible read options including timeout-based reads, exact size reads, and delimiter reads.
weaknesses: Platform support is strictly limited to Windows.
Port instances use a singleton pattern, requiring care when managing multiple connections or instances.
data.setup_notes: Requires Windows. Only supports Windows platform.
